name: LinkSquares
description_en:
LinkSquares combines contract intelligence, AI-assisted drafting and review, workflows, renewal tracking and reporting. LinkAI is the AI foundation across these capabilities; current product pages describe Workflow Builder Agent and reusable Workflow Blueprints rather than only a post-signature PDF archive.

Its distinctive workflow promise is to turn described business requirements into a configuration that the team reviews before publication. A workflow blueprint defines process steps; a contract template defines agreement content. Those are different reusable assets and need separate governance.
description_zh:
LinkSquares 结合合同智能、AI 辅助起草审阅、流程、续约跟踪及报表，LinkAI 为这些功能提供 AI 基础。当前产品页介绍 Workflow Builder Agent 和可复用 Workflow Blueprints，而不仅是签后 PDF 档案库。

其流程特点是将业务描述转成配置，再由团队复核后发布。流程蓝本定义过程步骤，合同模板定义协议内容；两种可复用资料需要分别管理。

core_features.explanation_en: Describe steps, dependencies and routing, then review the generated configuration before publishing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 描述步骤、依赖及路由，再复核生成配置后发布。

core_features.explanation_en: Adapt prebuilt processes for NDA intake, drafting, DPA review or SaaS purchasing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 改造预置 NDA 申请、起草、DPA 审阅或 SaaS 采购流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Route work by criteria such as value and vendor risk, with designated users or groups.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按金额、供应商风险等条件路由，并指定用户或组。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_zh: 改造 SaaS 采购蓝本
sections.en: The automation page lists SaaS purchasing among its Workflow Blueprints. A team could adapt one to collect a vendor request, generate the agreement and route higher-risk or higher-value purchases to additional reviewers. Specify who may launch that workflow, not just who receives an approval. Check a missing risk value, changed amount and denied request before publishing. This is a proposed evaluation, not a tested template.
sections.zh: 自动化页把 SaaS 采购列为 Workflow Blueprints 场景。团队可改造蓝本，收集供应商申请、生成协议，并把较高风险或金额的采购交给额外审阅人。除了审批收件人，还要规定谁能发起流程。发布前可检查风险值缺失、金额变化和拒绝申请情形；这是评估建议，并非已测试模板。

sections.title_en: A generated workflow still needs a responsible reviewer
sections.title_zh: 生成流程仍需负责人复核
sections.en: Workflow Builder Agent assembles steps, sequence, dependencies and routing from plain-language instructions. The page explicitly describes reviewing and refining that configuration before publication, and modifying it when policy changes. Inspect the actual conditions and role assignments rather than accepting the agent’s explanation alone. This differs from reviewing the text of a contract generated inside the process.
sections.zh: Workflow Builder Agent 从自然语言指令组装步骤、顺序、依赖和路由。页面明确描述发布前复核调整配置，并在政策变化时修改。应检查实际条件及角色分配，不能只接受 Agent 的解释。这与审阅流程内生成的合同文本不同。

sections.title_en: Keep agreement intelligence tied to operational records
sections.title_zh: 让合同智能关联运营记录
sections.en: The current platform describes contract intelligence, renewals and obligations, reporting, and APIs/integrations. Legal, procurement and sales can therefore have different views of the same contracting work. Decide which fields are authoritative and who corrects extracted information; a useful summary does not establish that a renewal reminder or downstream record was updated. Specific connector directions and failure handling were not verified here.
sections.zh: 当前平台介绍合同智能、续约及义务、报表和 API／集成，法务、采购和销售可围绕同一合同工作使用不同信息。应明确字段权威来源及信息提取修正人；摘要有用不等于续约提醒或下游记录已更新。本文未核实具体连接器方向及失败处理。

sections.title_en: Quote users, contracts, modules and onboarding together
sections.title_zh: 同时询价用户、合同、模块及上线支持
sections.en: The official pricing page lists contract volume, user count, selected modules, implementation/onboarding and custom integrations or advanced features as pricing factors. It does not publish a verified numeric payable amount. Ask for those factors in a dated proposal and distinguish recurring subscription from one-time implementation. The vendor’s statement about upfront costs is not an independent audit of a buyer’s total bill.
sections.zh: 官方定价页列出合同量、用户数、所选模块、实施／上线支持，以及自定义集成或高级功能等定价因素，未公布可核实的数字应付金额。应把这些项目列入当日报价，并区分持续订阅与一次实施。厂商关于费用透明的说明，不是对买方总账单的独立审计。

sections.title_en: Evaluate lifecycle coordination, not only AI text generation
sections.title_zh: 评估生命周期协作，而不只是 AI 文本生成
sections.en: Teams with recurring contract requests and cross-functional approvals have a concrete use case. A person seeking only a clause rewrite may not need a complete governed platform. Start with a blueprint, approved document template, owners and a small existing contract set. The pages describe a hosted product; no self-hosted distribution, open-source licence, recovery commitment or independent AI benchmark was verified.
sections.zh: 持续收到合同申请、需要跨团队审批的组织有具体使用场景。只想改写一条条款的个人，可能无需完整治理平台。可从蓝本、批准文档模板、负责人和少量既有合同开始。页面介绍托管产品，未核实自托管发行版、开源许可、恢复承诺或独立 AI 基准。
